display.purpose: Hero titles and major section headers (Space Grotesk).

title.purpose: Poster card titles and media names.

body.purpose: Synopsis text and long descriptions (Instrument Sans).

label.purpose: Resolution badges, release years, and kickers (IBM Plex Mono).

shadows.name: ambient-glow
shadows.purpose: Diffuse dark aura behind floating glass panels.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Subtle hover lift on interactive media cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button for starting playback or primary form submits.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.62 0.1 182); color: oklch(0.15 0.01 240); padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 12px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Glassmorphic secondary action button for media details.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(30, 36, 48, 0.75); color: oklch(0.95 0.008 240); padding: 10px 24px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.012 240 / 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(0.27 0.012 240); }

components.name: Poster Card
components.description: 2/3 aspect ratio media poster card with hover scaling and shadow depth.
components.css: .ds-card-media { background: oklch(0.19 0.012 240); border: 1px solid oklch(0.29 0.012 240 / 0.55); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px; width: 190px; color: oklch(0.95 0.008 240); transition: all 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-media:hover { border-color: oklch(0.62 0.1 182 / 0.5); transform: scale(1.025); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-card-poster { background: oklch(0.23 0.01 240); aspect-ratio: 2/3; border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 4px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-card-meta { font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; color: oklch(0.72 0.012 240); }

narrative.overview: FishyStream's design system establishes a high-contrast, immersive dark environment built for zero-friction media discovery and video playback. Deep ocean dark backgrounds lit by indigo/cyan highlights, clean display typography, and tactile glassmorphic containers.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic Radial Gradients: Radial background glows blending primary cyan at 16% and 8% opacity onto dark slate canvas.
Theme & Accent Customization: Supports runtime theme switches (dark, light) and custom accents (cyan, indigo, rose, emerald).
Dynamic Density & Corner Radii: Configurable density modes (compact, touch) and radius styles (sharp, rounded, playful).
Glassmorphism & Surface Elevation: Backdrop-blurred cards with fine borders.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary cyan accenting is used on ≤10% of any screen viewport.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: All section kickers and metadata labels use .eyebrow or .text-label with uppercase and tracking-[0.2em].

rules.name: The Tonal Surface Rule
rules.body: Layering proceeds from canvas (--surface-1), card containers (--surface-2), to popovers/modals (--surface-3).

dos: Do place all persistent AI context files in docs/ (docs/PRODUCT.md, docs/DESIGN.md).
Do honor touch target sizes (minimum 44x44px .touch-target) on mobile viewports.
Do use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) on fixed mobile navigation bars to support native gesture bars.
donts: Don't rely on hover-only states for critical playback or navigation actions on touch screens.
Don't override OKLCH color variables with arbitrary hex colors in component inline styles.
Don't remove backdrop-blur-xl or glassmorphic styling from sticky topbars or navigation rails.
